notes.title: New Version Incoming! Full Gameplay Reveal!
notes.notes:
"Hide the bullet? Dare to bet? Call out the bluff?"
​4-Player Revolver Showdown: Psychological Warfare & Luck's Ultimate Test!​​



Core Rules Decoded​

​Setup:

4 players, 1 revolver + 1 live bullet each

​Lives: 3 lives per player. Lose 1 life per hit. Win by surviving till the end or scoring ​13 points first.

​Key Mechanics:

​Bullet Concealment: Hide your live bullet or play with it openly.

​High-Stakes Betting: Wager on how many shots you'll take this round (0-5).

​Bluff Call-Out: Accuse opponents of hiding bullets. Guess right = their life lost; guess wrong = you gain a bullet.



Turn-by-Turn Breakdown

Preparation Phase​

Load 1 live bullet into your revolver (rest are blanks).

​Critical Choice: Conceal the bullet or play with it.

​Betting Phase​

Bet on shots you'll take (0-5).

​Strategy: Higher bets = bigger rewards but riskier odds!

​Bluff Call-Out

Accuse any player of hiding bullets.

​Outcome: If correct, the accused loses 1 life; if wrong, you add a bullet.

Shooting Phase

Spin the revolver, aim at yourself, and pull the trigger.

​Survive: Earn betting points (e.g., 3 shots = 3 points).

​Hit: Lose 1 life. Zero lives? Eliminated!

Score Settlement

End of each round: Tally points. First to ​13 points​ or last survivor wins!
